scientific_integrity: Mathematical identities proved using telegraph resolvents, Poisson marking and renewal splitting. Independent third-party validation not performed. Simulations are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Independent particle clocks, symmetric velocity resampling, stationary displacement initialization, Poisson anchor disorder; fixed positive velocity-flip rate for large-time asymptotics; no finite-sample claim.
title: Exact two-time current covariance and ballistic memory in a resetting run-and-tumble gas
